value.rationale: The result determines the entire rank polynomial for natural multiplicative projections on the smallest central-simple associative matrix algebra across all finite fields, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Its contribution is the arithmetic separation and recombination of split, extension-field and dual-number subalgebras and of unital/nonunital complement geometries; this exact rank distribution can be used for Rota-Baxter splitting and Nijenhuis census benchmarks.
